Meme.title: Meme
Meme.description: Represents a user-created meme with caption, visuals, metadata, and community engagement.

imageUrl.description: Image or video URL of the meme background

humorStyle.description: Category or comedic tone of the meme

layout.description: Layout style such as classic, modern, or banner

creatorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator

isChallengeEntry.description: Whether this meme was submitted for a daily challenge

challengeTheme.description: Daily challenge theme title if applicable

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores user points, pro status, badges, and challenge achievements across devices.

email.description: User email address if authenticated via Google

completedChallenges.description: Date keys of completed daily challenges

/users/{userId}.description: User personal cloud profile and cross-device sync data
